##### Project general facts

Amara is an elegant and elevated residential neighbourhood comprised of 116 distinctive twin villas, each designed to celebrate a relaxed hillside way of life. The twin villas showcase a graceful interplay between pairs of adjoining volumes, with one-third of each home recessed to create a welcoming entrance and a dynamic, sculptural street facade. Spanning three floors, every villa offers generous family living, complete with semi-outdoor areas that draw greenery right into the living quarters and frame the scenic landscape on both sides.

Life at Amara unfolds around a lush central park where residents can enjoy a resort-style swimming pool with sun loungers and shaded cabanas, a sports and paddle court, and an adventure playground for children. A wide event lawn with amphitheatre seating invites yoga sessions, picnics and community gatherings, while meandering walking and jogging pathways, pergola-shaded promenades and beautifully manicured gardens connect every corner of the neighbourhood. Landscaping inspired by desert dunes, Ghaf trees and flowing wadis creates a vibrant, evergreen setting that pleases the eye and soothes the soul.

The interiors are a signature collaboration with Bergman Design House, a celebrated luxury studio that brought Amara to life with a light and organic palette carved with rich layers of Zen. Refined natural stone flooring, warm timber joinery, herringbone parquet in the bedrooms, dramatic veined marble in the master bathroom and sleek stone kitchen counters come together in a truly calm and mesmeric composition. Delicate accents of brushed metal and fluted glass, sculptural lighting and expert craftsmanship complete a home that offers intimacy, privacy and a peaceful sanctuary in which to recharge.

##### Location description and benefits

Tilal Al Ghaf is a visionary mixed-use community that redefines modern living in Dubai. Nestled in a prime location, this masterfully planned development seamlessly integrates residential, commercial, and recreational elements to create a vibrant and sustainable neighborhood.

Spread across a vast expanse, Tilal Al Ghaf offers a diverse range of living options, from contemporary villas and townhouses to apartments, providing residents with a choice that suits their lifestyle preferences. The community prioritizes green spaces, parks, and landscaped areas, fostering a connection with nature amidst the urban setting.

Designed with a holistic approach, Tilal Al Ghaf incorporates world-class amenities, including schools, healthcare facilities, shopping destinations, and recreational spaces. The centerpiece of this community is the stunning Lagoon Al Ghaf, a vast artificial lagoon surrounded by a sandy beach, offering residents a unique waterfront experience.
